prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Redesigning the sign_in page for account sync clarity was helpful (+8.0% win) with accurate predictions, but hint and layout modifications showed no clear effect.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow (new_flow) on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win) despite predictions being slightly high (+10.0%), while other adoption modifications showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8% loss) where predictions (+5.0%) were far too high; layout, hint, and copy changes showed no clear effect.
Redesigning the finish page for desktop placement celebration was highly helpful (+26.0% win) where predictions (-5.0%) were far too low, though an earlier finish redesign and hints showed no clear effect.
Audio completion notifications on the home page hurt performance (-6.3% loss), while other home page modifications (waiting info, new flows, and notification prompts) showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +7.4% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +7.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.9% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +2.7% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -5.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.9% over 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -0.7% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.7% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: +4.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +8.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 75.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.0%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Trait Quiz Flow: Inserts an interactive trait preference quiz screen into the adoption sequence before photo upload. (why: The adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (64.5%) and high median completion time (89s), showing users need clearer personality guidance.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Quick Setup Guide: Adds an interactive quick controls tutorial component to the home intro screen detailing key pet interactions. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
2: [adoption, layout] Dual-Column Photo & Trait Customizer: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to two_column, displaying companion style selections and trait highlights side-by-side. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest completion rate (64.5%), so side-by-side visual clarity helps decision-making.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Outcome Clarity Headline: Updates headline and body copy on choose_path to explain that selected paths can be changed anytime in pet settings. (why: High mean time of 514s on choose_path suggests users hesitate out of fear of making an unchangeable commitment.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Milestone Visual Progress Tracker: Enables detailed stage progress bar and estimated time updates on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting home step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s; displaying clear progress milestones sets user expectations.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Sync Security Assurance Note: Adds a persistent security hint under sign-in choices confirming pet progress and data are safely backed up. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)

scores.note: Adoption step has the highest dropoff (35.5%), and interactive new flows on adoption have a strong proven track record (+7.4% average).
Strong support email evidence addressing pet control confusion, but new flows on post-adoption steps have mixed performance.
Targets the highest dropoff step with a layout change; layout modifications show modest positive lifts overall.
Low-cost copy update addressing long step duration, but copy changes typically produce minimal relative impact (+0.9%).
High wait time on home, but wait_info modifications have consistently shown negative performance (-1.7% across 3 tests).
Direct support mail evidence for sign-in pet sync concerns, but hint additions historically underperform (-1.0% to -5.0%).
